post.description:
Dynamically calculates prices for all applicable plans based on:
- Selected region (determines base price and JagBani availability)
- Cities: ALL Cities uses region's allCitiesPrice; specific cities sums their adPrice
- Industry: applies price multiplier on top of base price
- Billing cycle: MONTHLY (no discount), QUARTERLY (10% off × 3 months), YEARLY (25% off × 12 months)
- Combo discount applied on JagBani + Punjab Kesari combined price
- Promotional discount applied site-wide
- JagBani & Combo plans only appear for JagBani-enabled regions (e.g., Punjab)

post.description: Voids the authorization and releases the held amount. The authenticated customer can void only their own HDFC card transaction; status is confirmed server-to-server.
Fetches HDFC order status server-to-server and verifies order ID and amount. AUTHORIZED represents a hold only; capture is required before payment completion and subscription activation.

get.description: Public browser return endpoint. CORS is limited to the configured HDFC SmartGateway UAT and production origins. Uses only order_id/orderId to trigger authoritative server-to-server reconciliation, then redirects to the frontend GET route. The frontend must call POST /payments/hdfc/verify; a browser return or gateway-posted status is not proof of payment.

303.description: See Other: browser redirected to the frontend return page using GET

400.description: Missing, conflicting, or invalid order ID

post.description: Public gateway callback. Accepts application/x-www-form-urlencoded, multipart/form-data, or application/json without authentication or a CSRF token. Only order_id/orderId identifies the local transaction; posted status, status_id, signature, signature_algorithm, and amount fields are ignored. Reconciles with HDFC server-to-server and responds with 303 See Other to the frontend GET route including order_id.

303.description: See Other: browser redirected to the frontend return page using GET

400.description: Missing, conflicting, or invalid order ID

post.summary: Capture an authorized HDFC card payment
post.description: Captures the full authorized amount only. The authenticated customer can capture only their own HDFC card transaction; status is confirmed server-to-server.

Releases the user's pending checkout only when HDFC authoritatively reports the order as NEW with no payment reference. The local transaction is marked ABANDONED, not CANCELLED, and remains eligible for late payment reconciliation.

sortOrder.description: Authoritative plan rank used by the backend to classify upgrades and downgrades.

autoRenew.description: When true with HDFC selected, checkout requires mandate consent and records the mandate only after server-verified registration success. This is not a frontend-controlled debit.

startDate.description: Authoritative validity start date; null while checkout is pending.

endDate.description: Authoritative validity end date; null while checkout is pending.

nextRenewalDate.description: Next calendar renewal date, when applicable.

autoRenew.description: Renewal preference; only an ACTIVE HDFC mandate authorizes scheduled server-side debits.

renewalPaymentMode.description: CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_REQUIRED unless an active HDFC mandate is attached; HDFC_MANDATE then denotes scheduled server-side debit, not guaranteed payment success.

current.description: True only for the customer's current active subscription.

pendingPlanName.description: Name of a scheduled lower plan.

targetPlanId.description: Target plan ID; price and plan rank are resolved by the backend.

targetBillingCycle.description: Target billing cycle, priced and validated by the backend.

paymentMethodId.description: Optional saved payment method owned by the authenticated client.

paymentMethodType.description: Payment method selection used to create the customer checkout; not a recurring mandate.
